title: 2 RC Airplanes and a Guest from Norway
description:
XK A1200 Specs and Pricing: https://amzn.to/2Blqhl4
XK 3D6G Specs and Pricing: https://amzn.to/2EyK5VZ
Heated Coat from Ororo: http://shrsl.com/1c99a
We fly two different foam, electric radio control airplanes and give you a look at each one. One is a smaller, sportier 3D airplane, the other is a larger, more gentle push propeller with great glide characteristics. If you are thinking about trying out a RC airplane, check these two out!
